scope.summary: Implement the low-level utility pixel operators as StudioLiveFilter kinds: Custom Convolution (user 5x5 kernel, scale/offset, savable/loadable), Maximum/dilate (radius, squareness/roundness; spread masks), Minimum/erode (radius; choke masks), Offset (h/v shift with wrap/repeat-edge/background fill), De-Interlace (odd/even line removal by duplication/interpolation), Broadcast-Safe Colors (TV-safe gamut). Watermark is a RETIRED third-party surface, recorded as provenance-only and NOT shipped as a native Studio effect.
acceptance_criteria: Custom Convolution, Maximum(dilate), Minimum(erode), Offset, De-Interlace, Broadcast-Safe Colors; Watermark provenance-only (not shipped)
expected_tests: test: Custom Convolution 5x5 kernel savable/loadable; Maximum/Minimum morphology choke/spread; Offset edge modes
test: Watermark NOT registered as a shippable effect_kind (provenance-only)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
